profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: How you appear to the rest of the team.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHelp: What people see instead of your username, in channels, mentions and members lists. Leave it empty and your username is used.
profile.emailHelp: Only to tell two accounts apart on a shared machine. cac sends no mail.
profile.usernameHelp: Your identifier: it's what you type after an @, and it can't be changed here.

mobile.label: Navigation
mobile.moreHint: The rest of the app: screens, spaces, organization and account.

mcp.lead: Claude Code talks to cac through cac-mcp, a small program that lives on this machine. Install it and keep it up to date here; nothing updates by itself.
mcp.missing: cac-mcp is not installed on this machine.
mcp.newer: A newer version is out: v{{version}}
mcp.unknownLatest: Could not check whether a newer version is out.
mcp.done: cac-mcp v{{version}} is installed. It takes effect in the next Claude Code session: /mcp → cac → reconnect, or open a new one.
mcp.failed: It could not be installed, and what was there is untouched.
mcp.tokenHelp: Put your personal token where it says {{placeholder}}. It is created in the previous cac app (account menu → Connect Claude Code); this app does not create tokens yet, and never shows them.

updater.available: A new version of cac is out: v{{version}}
updater.ready: Updated to v{{version}}. Restart to use it.
updater.installReady: v{{version}} is downloaded. The app closes to install it; save what you are doing first.
updater.diskOpened: The disk image is open: drag the app to Applications to finish.
updater.manual: This install is updated with your package manager or by hand.
updater.failed: It could not be updated, and what was there is untouched.
updater.restartFailed: It could not be restarted. Close the app and open it again.
